items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: From 1930 I had met a chanteuse by the name of Clara Campbell

ctx.x: Guitar. He would pick the tunes. "You can have this one." "Penthouse Serenade," all of those things; I took those things. I was the first one to sing them over the radio because I found out something years ago. From 1930 I had met a chanteuse by the name of Clara Campbell and she used to always write in to New York into Tin Pan Alley and get these songs that's going to be the hit.
